testFuzz_Fork_GasStarvedProbeCannotQuara.notice: White-hat: starve the real USDC blacklist probe of gas (63/64 rule) so it "fails" and fail-closed quarantine freezes a clean slot. Must not work.

test_Fork_OverpaidPriorityTipStillSweeps.notice: Regression for the live testnet failure: overpaid priority tip on a real Arc base fee must not trip GasTooHigh.

test_Fork_RealUsdcAcceptsAnyNonBlacklist.notice: White-hat (re Studio AUDIT-v6 C-1): real Arc USDC is a plain ERC-20 with no receiver hooks, so contracts, precompiles and fresh addresses all receive sweeps fine. What it does refuse is blacklisted addresses — and Circle blacklists the USDC contract itself, which as a payout would lock the slot in quarantine forever. The factory now rejects that up front.
